title: Less Is Moral: A CHARMing Framework for Moral Foundations Detection in Endorsement Behaviour
reasoning: The paper introduces CHARM, a framework designed to detect moral foundations in text. It builds on psychological theories, such as Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) and Morality-as-Cooperation (MAC), and evaluates the moral reasoning and alignment (moral homophily) of LLMs in morally charged social discourse.
